name: 树莓派 M.2 HAT+ 装配 SOP
name_en: Raspberry Pi M.2 HAT+ Assembly SOP
_note: 工时取实测值：拧一颗 M2.5 螺丝 8~10 秒（CLAUDE.md「不要用别的任务的经验值外推」）。本 demo 不做超时/过快告警，工时只用来画 HUD 进度条，不产生事件。

steps.en: installing the first screw at the top-left hole
steps.instruction: 把板子平放桌面，拧入 ① 左上角螺丝。
steps.tip: 拧完双手退出画面停 2 秒，系统需要一帧无遮挡的画面确认。
steps.instruction_en: Lay the board flat on the desk and drive screw ① into the top-left hole.
steps.tip_en: When you're done, move both hands out of view for two seconds — the system needs one unobstructed frame to confirm.

steps.en: installing the second screw at the bottom-right hole
steps.instruction: 对角紧固：拧入 ② 右下角螺丝。
steps.tip: 对角顺序能让板子受力均匀，别按顺时针来。
steps.instruction_en: Tighten diagonally: drive screw ② into the bottom-right hole.
steps.tip_en: Diagonal order loads the board evenly. Don't go around clockwise.

steps.en: installing the third screw at the top-right hole
steps.instruction: 拧入 ③ 右上角螺丝。
steps.tip: 右侧中部 ⑤⑥ 两孔是 M.2 固定孔，永远不装。
steps.instruction_en: Drive screw ③ into the top-right hole.
steps.tip_en: The two middle-right holes ⑤⑥ are M.2 mounting holes — they never get screws.

steps.en: installing the fourth screw at the bottom-left hole
steps.instruction: 拧入 ④ 左下角螺丝，四角完成。
steps.tip: 四颗到位后才会开始判排线，这一步别急着插排线。
steps.instruction_en: Drive screw ④ into the bottom-left hole. That completes all four corners.
steps.tip_en: Ribbon-cable checking only starts once all four screws are confirmed — don't plug it in yet.

steps.en: seating the FPC ribbon cable into the connector
steps.instruction: 把 FPC 排线插入板子左缘连接器，压下卡扣。
steps.tip: 插好的特征是排线折起、金色补强板朝上；平摊向左＝没插。
steps.instruction_en: Insert the FPC ribbon cable into the connector on the board's left edge and press the latch down.
steps.tip_en: Seated looks like this: the cable folds back with the gold stiffener facing up. Lying flat to the left means it is not seated.

_note_speech: speech 字段专供语音播报：括号会被念成「左括号」、FPC 会被逐字母念，所以屏幕文字和念出来的话分开写。
_note_lang: 每步的显示文案中英各一套：zh/instruction/tip/speech 与 title_en/instruction_en/tip_en/speech_en。--lang 选哪套。英文模式下 Spec 会把 title_en 装进 steps[].zh —— 复用的 xr.html 的 stepLabel() 只认那个字段，见 guidance_text.py 模块头 ②。en 字段是给 VLM prompt 的动名词短语，与 HUD 无关，别混用。
